fn served() {
    let l = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let port = l.local_addr().unwrap().port();
    std::thread::spawn(move || { let _ = l.accept(); });
    get(port);
}

fn serve() -> (TcpListener, u16) {
    let l = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let p = l.local_addr().unwrap().port();
    (l, p)
}

fn after_last_use() {
    let silent = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let mut m = mail(silent.local_addr().unwrap().port());
    send(&m);
    drop(silent);
    let mut m = mail(1);
    send(&m);
}

fn held() {
    let held = HeldPort::reset();
    get(held.port());
}

fn masked() {
    // let p = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap().local_addr().unwrap().port();
    let s = r#"TcpListener::bind("x").unwrap().local_addr()"#;
    let q = '"';
    /* TcpListener::bind("a").unwrap().local_addr() */
}
